beats.say: The label on an official document says who may see it. Let us learn to read these marks.
The label sits in the subject, at the top or in the file name. Pause before you share.

body.text: This draft is for heads of department only. Do not send it to anyone else.

beats.say: The core rule is need to know: only people who truly need the document for their work see it.
Rank, friendship or curiosity is not a reason. Even without a label, citizens' data stays protected.

scenes.prompt: Match each label with its meaning.

pairs.right: Anyone may see it, for example a notice published on the website
Inside the institution, only those who need it for work
Only authorised people, under special rules
Still protected: citizens' data is not public

scenes.explain: Label names and rules can differ between institutions. Always follow your own institution's instructions.

scenes.prompt: Can you fulfil this request or not?

body.text: Hi! Send me the draft budget too, just curious whose salary goes up.

cards.explain: Curiosity is not a need. If HR does not work with this document, do not send it.

body.text: Please send me the team's report through SənədAxını, we present it to the ministry tomorrow.

cards.explain: Your manager works with this document and asks for the official system. This is normal work.

body.text: I hear you are drafting a new order. Snap a photo of the draft, nobody will know.

cards.explain: An unpublished order does not leave the institution. Friendship is not a need to know.

body.text: Could you send us the text of the notice published on the website yesterday?

cards.explain: The notice is already public. Public information can be shared.

body.text: Hi, I am new here. Please send me the list of everyone in the department with their phone numbers.

cards.explain: A new employee gets such a list through their manager. Send nothing to an unknown number.

scenes.title: Morning requests
scenes.intro: You have four emails. In each one, look at who wants what, then decide.

body.text: Hi! Could you forward me the draft budget from Finance? I just want to have a look.

steps.say: Does Tural work with this document?

actions.label: Forward
actions.feedback: Tural does not work with this document. A labelled document goes only to those who need it.

actions.label: Reply: manager approval needed
actions.feedback: Right. If there is a real need, a manager approves it the official way.

body.text: Nərmin Hüseynova sent you a task. Open SənədAxını to see it.

actions.label: Mark as safe
actions.feedback: Right. An expected task from the internal system, with no link to click.

actions.label: Report phishing
actions.feedback: Not every email is a threat. Sender, address and content are what you expect.

body.text: For a joint project, send the names, positions and mobile numbers of your department's staff to this address today.

actions.label: Report phishing
actions.feedback: Right. A ministry does not write from a free mail service, official requests come as letters.

actions.label: Send the list
actions.feedback: Your colleagues' data went to a scammer. Now each of them can get a targeted email.

actions.label: Open attachment
actions.feedback: This email was not meant for you. Opening it out of curiosity is also a leak.

actions.label: Forward to Rəşad
actions.feedback: Kind intent, but you spread the mistake further. The sender should fix it.

actions.label: Tell the sender it reached the wrong person
actions.feedback: Right. Tell the sender, do not open the attachment, and delete the email as your institution requires.

question.prompt: A friend at another ministry asks for a report labelled "For official use only".

options.label: I send it, they are a civil servant too
options.feedback: Being a civil servant is not a need to know. Another institution's request comes as an official letter.

options.label: I ask for an official request and tell my manager
options.feedback: Right. Management assesses the official request and the institution answers it.

options.label: I do not send it, but I tell them the key figures
options.feedback: The figures are part of the document. Telling them is sharing too.

scenes.explain: Need to know and permission decide, not the channel. Management decides the official way.

points: The label says who may see a document: check it before sharing.
Show it only to those who need it for work, not out of curiosity or friendship.
Do not open a document sent to you by mistake, tell the sender.
